versos.hebraico: ט֤וֹב פַּ֣ת חֲ֭רֵבָה וְשַׁלְוָה־בָ֑הּ מִ֝בַּ֗יִת מָלֵ֥א זִבְחֵי־רִֽיב׃

controles.web: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
controles.kjv: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
controles.livre: Melhor é um pedaço seco de comida com tranquilidade, do que uma casa cheia de carne com briga.

versos.hebraico: עֶֽבֶד־מַשְׂכִּ֗יל יִ֭מְשֹׁל בְּבֵ֣ן מֵבִ֑ישׁ וּבְת֥וֹךְ אַ֝חִ֗ים יַחֲלֹ֥ק נַחֲלָֽה׃

controles.web: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.
controles.kjv: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
controles.livre: O servo prudente dominará o filho causador de vergonha, e receberá parte da herança entre os irmãos.

versos.hebraico: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וּבֹחֵ֖ן לִבּ֣וֹת יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.
controles.kjv: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the Lord trieth the hearts.
controles.livre: O crisol é para a prata, e o forno para o ouro; mas o SENHOR prova os corações.

versos.hebraico: מֵ֭רַע מַקְשִׁ֣יב עַל־שְׂפַת־אָ֑וֶן שֶׁ֥קֶר מֵ֝זִין עַל־לְשׁ֥וֹן הַוֺּֽת׃

controles.web: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
controles.kjv: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
controles.livre: O malfeitor presta atenção ao lábio injusto; o mentiroso inclina os ouvidos à língua maligna.

versos.hebraico: לֹעֵ֣ג לָ֭רָשׁ חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ שָׂמֵ֥חַ לְ֝אֵ֗יד לֹ֣א יִנָּקֶֽה׃

controles.web: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.
controles.kjv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
controles.livre: Quem ridiculariza o pobre insulta o seu Criador; aquele que se alegra da calamidade não ficará impune.

versos.hebraico: עֲטֶ֣רֶת זְ֭קֵנִים בְּנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים וְתִפְאֶ֖רֶת בָּנִ֣ים אֲבוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children are their parents.
controles.kjv: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
controles.livre: A coroa dos idosos são os filhos de seus filhos; e a glória dos filhos são seus pais.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־נָאוָ֣ה לְנָבָ֣ל שְׂפַת־יֶ֑תֶר אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־לְנָדִ֥יב שְׂפַת־שָֽׁקֶר׃

controles.web: Arrogant speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.
controles.kjv: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
controles.livre: Não é adequado ao tolo falar com elegância; muito menos para o príncipe falar mentiras.

versos.hebraico: אֶֽבֶן־חֵ֣ן הַ֭שֹּׁחַד בְּעֵינֵ֣י בְעָלָ֑יו אֶֽל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִפְנֶ֣ה יַשְׂכִּֽיל׃

controles.web: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.
controles.kjv: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
controles.livre: O presente é como uma pedra preciosa aos olhos de seus donos; para onde quer que se voltar, tentará ter algum proveito.

versos.hebraico: מְֽכַסֶּה־פֶּ֭שַׁע מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אַהֲבָ֑ה וְשֹׁנֶ֥ה בְ֝דָבָ֗ר מַפְרִ֥יד אַלּֽוּף׃

controles.web: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.
controles.kjv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
controles.livre: Quem perdoa a transgressão busca a amizade; mas quem repete o assunto afasta amigos íntimos.

versos.hebraico: תֵּ֣חַת גְּעָרָ֣ה בְמֵבִ֑ין מֵהַכּ֖וֹת כְּסִ֣יל מֵאָֽה׃

controles.web: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.
controles.kjv: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
controles.livre: A repreensão entra mais profundamente no prudente do que cem açoites no tolo.

versos.hebraico: אַךְ־מְרִ֥י יְבַקֶּשׁ־רָ֑ע וּמַלְאָ֥ךְ אַ֝כְזָרִ֗י יְשֻׁלַּח־בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
controles.kjv: An evil man seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
controles.livre: Na verdade quem é mal busca somente a rebeldia; mas o mensageiro cruel será enviado contra ele.

versos.hebraico: פָּג֬וֹשׁ דֹּ֣ב שַׁכּ֣וּל בְּאִ֑ישׁ וְאַל־כְּ֝סִ֗יל בְּאִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
controles.kjv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
controles.livre: É melhor ao homem encontrar uma ursa roubada de seus filhotes ,do que um tolo em sua loucura.

versos.hebraico: מֵשִׁ֣יב רָ֭עָה תַּ֣חַת טוֹבָ֑ה לֹא־תמיש רָ֝עָ֗ה מִבֵּיתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
controles.kjv: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
controles.livre: Quanto ao que devolve o mal no lugar do bem, o mal nunca se afastará de sua casa.

versos.hebraico: פּ֣וֹטֵֽר מַ֭יִם רֵאשִׁ֣ית מָד֑וֹן וְלִפְנֵ֥י הִ֝תְגַּלַּ֗ע הָרִ֥יב נְטֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.
controles.kjv: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
controles.livre: Começar uma briga é como deixar águas rolarem; por isso, abandona a discussão antes que haja irritação.

versos.hebraico: מַצְדִּ֣יק רָ֭שָׁע וּמַרְשִׁ֣יעַ צַדִּ֑יק תּוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְ֝הוָ֗ה גַּם־שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
controles.kjv: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to the Lord.
controles.livre: Quem absolve ao perverso e quem condena ao justo, ambos são abomináveis ao SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: לָמָּה־זֶּ֣ה מְחִ֣יר בְּיַד־כְּסִ֑יל לִקְנ֖וֹת חָכְמָ֣ה וְלֶב־אָֽיִן׃

controles.web: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
controles.kjv: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he hath no heart to it?
controles.livre: Para que serve o dinheiro na mão do tolo, já que ele não tem interesse em obter sabedoria?

versos.hebraico: בְּכָל־עֵ֭ת אֹהֵ֣ב הָרֵ֑עַ וְאָ֥ח לְ֝צָרָ֗ה יִוָּלֵֽד׃

controles.web: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
controles.kjv: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
controles.livre: O amigo ama em todo tempo, e o irmão nasce para ajudar na angústia.

versos.hebraico: אָדָ֣ם חֲסַר־לֵ֭ב תּוֹקֵ֣עַ כָּ֑ף עֹרֵ֥ב עֲ֝רֻבָּ֗ה לִפְנֵ֥י רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.
controles.kjv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
controles.livre: O homem imprudente assume compromisso, ficando como fiador de seu próximo.

versos.hebraico: אֹ֣הֵֽב פֶּ֭שַׁע אֹהֵ֣ב מַצָּ֑ה מַגְבִּ֥יהַּ פִּ֝תְח֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־שָֽׁבֶר׃

controles.web: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.
controles.kjv: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
controles.livre: Quem ama a briga, ama a transgressão; quem constrói alta sua porta busca ruína.

versos.hebraico: עִקֶּשׁ־לֵ֭ב לֹ֣א יִמְצָא־ט֑וֹב וְנֶהְפָּ֥ךְ בִּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ יִפּ֥וֹל בְּרָעָֽה׃

controles.web: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
controles.kjv: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
controles.livre: O perverso de coração nunca encontrará o bem; e quem distorce as palavras de sua língua cairá no mal.

versos.hebraico: יֹלֵ֣ד כְּ֭סִיל לְת֣וּגָה ל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח אֲבִ֣י נָבָֽל׃

controles.web: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.
controles.kjv: He that begetteth a fool doeth it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
controles.livre: Quem gera o louco cria sua própria tristeza; e o pai do imprudente não se alegrará.

versos.hebraico: לֵ֣ב שָׂ֭מֵחַ יֵיטִ֣ב גֵּהָ֑ה וְר֥וּחַ נְ֝כֵאָ֗ה תְּיַבֶּשׁ־גָּֽרֶם׃

controles.web: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.
controles.kjv: A merry heart doeth good like a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
controles.livre: O coração alegre é um bom remédio, mas o espírito abatido faz os ossos se secarem.

versos.hebraico: שֹׁ֣חַד מֵ֭חֵיק רָשָׁ֣ע יִקָּ֑ח לְ֝הַטּ֗וֹת אָרְח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.
controles.kjv: A wicked man taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
controles.livre: O perverso toma o presente do seio, para perverter os caminhos da justiça.

versos.hebraico: אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י מֵבִ֣ין חָכְמָ֑ה וְעֵינֵ֥י כְ֝סִ֗יל בִּקְצֵה־אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.
controles.kjv: Wisdom is before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
controles.livre: A sabedoria está diante do rosto do prudente; porém os olhos do tolo estão voltados para os confins da terra.

versos.hebraico: כַּ֣עַס לְ֭אָבִיו בֵּ֣ן כְּסִ֑יל וּ֝מֶ֗מֶר לְיוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.
controles.kjv: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
controles.livre: O filho tolo é tristeza para seu pai, e amargura para aquela que o gerou.

versos.hebraico: גַּ֤ם עֲנ֣וֹשׁ לַצַּדִּ֣יק לֹא־ט֑וֹב לְהַכּ֖וֹת נְדִיבִ֣ים עַל־יֹֽשֶׁר׃

controles.web: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.
controles.kjv: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
controles.livre: Também não é bom punir ao justo, nem bater nos príncipes por causa da justiça.

versos.hebraico: חוֹשֵׂ֣ךְ אֲ֭מָרָיו יוֹדֵ֣עַ דָּ֑עַת וקר־ר֝֗וּחַ אִ֣ישׁ תְּבוּנָֽה׃

controles.web: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.
controles.kjv: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
controles.livre: Quem entende o conhecimento guarda suas palavras; e o homem de bom entendimento é de espírito calmo.

versos.hebraico: גַּ֤ם אֱוִ֣יל מַ֭חֲרִישׁ חָכָ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב אֹטֵ֖ם שְׂפָתָ֣יו נָבֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
controles.kjv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shutteth his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
controles.livre: Até o tolo, quando está calado, é considerado como sábio; e quem fecha seus lábios, como de bom senso.
